// Tool delegation for external CLIs

## 2. Chat API Endpoints - Complete Structure

### Application → Chat Session Flow

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                          CHAT SESSION HIERARCHY                              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                              │
│   Application (appName)                                                      │
│   └── AI Category                                                            │
│       └── Chat Sessions                                                      │
│           ├── 01-{session-id}.db                                            │
│           ├── 02-{session-id}.db                                            │
│           └── ...                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│   Example Path: gsearch/ai/chat/05-abc123.db                                │
│                                                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Explicit API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `/api/v1/chat/sessions` | POST | Create new chat session |
| `/api/v1/chat/sessions` | GET | List all sessions (optionally by appName) |
| `/api/v1/chat/sessions/:id` | GET | Get session details |
| `/api/v1/chat/sessions/:id/messages` | POST | Send new message (streaming) |
| `/api/v1/chat/sessions/:id/messages` | GET | Get all messages in session |

### Create Session Request

```json
POST /api/v1/chat/sessions
{
  "appName": "gsearch",          // Source application
  "category": "thinking",        // Model category to use
  "title": "Project Planning"    // Human-readable title
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "sessionId": "chat_abc123",    // Unique session ID
  "sequenceNum": 5,              // Auto-incremented (01, 02, 03...)
  "path": "gsearch/ai/chat/05-abc123.db",
  "createdAt": "2026-02-01T10:30:00Z"
}
```

### Send Message (with Streaming)

```json
POST /api/v1/chat/sessions/chat_abc123/messages
{
  "content": "What's the best approach for caching?",
  "attachments": [
    {
      "type": "file",
      "name": "code.go",
      "content": "// source code..."
    }
  ]
}
```

**SSE Stream Response:**
```
event: message.started
data: {"messageId": "msg_xyz789", "role": "assistant"}

event: chunk
data: {"delta": "For implementing"}

event: chunk
data: {"delta": " a cache layer, "}

event: message.completed
data: {"messageId": "msg_xyz789", "tokens": 523}
```

## 3. RAG Memory - Data Structure & Loading

### Storage Structure

```
data/
└── {appName}/
    └── rag/
        └── documents/
            ├── 01-{doc-id}.db    # Each document = separate SQLite file
            ├── 02-{doc-id}.db
            └── ...
```

### Database Schema (Per Document)

```sql
-- Document metadata
CREATE TABLE document_meta (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 'singleton',
    doc_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    source_path TEXT,
    source_type TEXT NOT NULL,          -- file, url, text
    title TEXT,
    mime_type TEXT,
    size_bytes INTEGER,
    chunk_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    embedding_model TEXT,               -- nomic-embed-text, etc.
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active'
);

-- Document chunks with embeddings
CREATE TABLE chunks (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    sequence_num INTEGER NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    embedding BLOB,                     -- Vector embedding (binary)
    token_count INTEGER,
    metadata TEXT,                      -- JSON: page, section, etc.
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
```

### How RAG Memory Loads on Chat Start

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         RAG CONTEXT LOADING FLOW                             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                              │
│   1. User sends message                                                      │
│      └── "For this codebase, explain the cache layer"                       │
│                                                                              │
│   2. Extract query context                                                   │
│      └── Keywords: "codebase", "cache", "layer"                             │
│                                                                              │
│   3. Vector search across RAG documents                                      │
│      └── POST /api/v1/rag/search                                            │
│          {                                                                   │
│            "appName": "my-project",                                         │
│            "query": "cache layer implementation",                           │
│            "topK": 5,                                                        │
│            "threshold": 0.7                                                  │
│          }                                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│   4. Retrieve matching chunks                                                │
│      └── SELECT content, score FROM chunks                                  │
│          WHERE vector_similarity(embedding, query_embedding) > threshold    │
│          ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT topK                                     │
│                                                                              │
│   5. Inject into system prompt                                               │
│      └── "Context from codebase:\n{chunk1}\n{chunk2}..."                   │
│                                                                              │
│   6. Send to LLM with enriched context                                       │
│                                                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### RAG Search Request

```json
POST /api/v1/rag/search
{
  "appName": "gsearch",
  "query": "How does the caching system work?",
  "topK": 5,
  "threshold": 0.7
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "docId": "doc_abc123",
      "chunkId": "chunk_xyz",
      "content": "The caching system uses a write-through strategy...",
      "score": 0.92,
      "metadata": {
        "page": 15,
        "section": "Caching Architecture"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## 6. Training Accuracy & Codebase Learning

### Ingestion Flow for Codebase Training

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       CODEBASE TRAINING PIPELINE                             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                              │
│   1. INGESTION                                                               │
│      aibridge ingest --repo /path/to/codebase --app my-project              │
│      └── Scan all source files                                               │
│      └── Parse with AST (Go, TS, JS, Python)                                │
│      └── Extract: functions, types, imports, comments                       │
│                                                                              │
│   2. CHUNKING                                                                │
│      └── Split by semantic boundaries (functions, classes)                  │
│      └── Configurable: chunkSize=512, chunkOverlap=50                       │
│      └── Preserve context: file path, line numbers                          │
│                                                                              │
│   3. EMBEDDING                                                               │
│      └── Generate embeddings: nomic-embed-text (768 dimensions)             │
│      └── Store in SQLite with BLOB column                                   │
│                                                                              │
│   4. INDEXING                                                                │
│      └── Build vector index for fast similarity search                      │
│      └── Store in: {app}/rag/indexes/01-{index-id}.db                       │
│                                                                              │
│   5. QUERY-TIME                                                              │
│      └── User asks: "How does the cache work?"                              │
│      └── Embed query → Search index → Retrieve top-K chunks                 │
│      └── Inject into LLM context                                            │
│                                                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Expected Accuracy

| Codebase Size | Chunk Strategy | Expected Accuracy |
|---------------|----------------|-------------------|
| Small (<10K LOC) | Full file chunks | 95%+ |
| Medium (10K-100K LOC) | Function-level | 90-95% |
| Large (100K+ LOC) | Semantic boundaries | 85-90% |

**Factors Affecting Accuracy:**
- Embedding model quality (nomic-embed-text is solid)
- Chunk size (too small = lost context, too large = noise)
- Query clarity (specific queries > vague queries)
- Code documentation quality (comments help)

## 7. WebSocket Streaming - Implementation

### ✅ Already Specified

| Feature | Status | Location |
|---------|--------|----------|
| WebSocket endpoint | ✅ | `ws://localhost:5040/api/v1/ws` |
| Token streaming | ✅ | SSE events: `chunk`, `done` |
| Chat message streaming | ✅ | Events: `message.started`, `chunk`, `message.completed` |
| Backend status updates | ✅ | Event: `backend.status` |
| Model switch notifications | ✅ | Event: `model.switched` |
| PowerShell output streaming | ✅ | Event: `command.output` |

### WebSocket Message Types

```typescript
// Frontend → Backend
type F2B = 'generate' | 'cancel' | 'chat.message';

// Backend → Frontend
type B2F = 
  | 'chunk'           // Token chunk during generation
  | 'done'            // Generation complete
  | 'error'           // Error occurred
  | 'chat.message'    // Chat message update
  | 'model.switched'  // Model changed
  | 'backend.status'  // Backend health change
  | 'command.output'  // PowerShell output
  ;
```

### Live Transfer Example (ChatGPT-style)

```javascript
const ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:5040/api/v1/ws');

ws.onmessage = (event) => {
  const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
  
  switch (data.type) {
    case 'message.started':
      // Create empty assistant message bubble
      appendMessage({ id: data.messageId, role: 'assistant', content: '' });
      break;
      
    case 'chunk':
      // Append token to current message (live typing effect)
      updateMessageContent(data.messageId, prev => prev + data.delta);
      break;
      
    case 'message.completed':
      // Mark message as complete, update token count
      finalizeMessage(data.messageId, { tokens: data.tokens });
      break;
      
    case 'error':
      // Display error in UI
      showError(data.code, data.message);
      break;
  }
};
```

### Error Reduction Strategies

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         ERROR PREVENTION CHECKLIST                           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                              │
│   ✅ VALIDATION LAYER                                                        │
│      • JSON schema validation on all inputs                                  │
│      • Request size limits (max 10MB files)                                 │
│      • Type checking at API boundaries                                       │
│                                                                              │
│   ✅ RETRY LOGIC                                                             │
│      • MaxAttempts: 3                                                        │
│      • InitialDelay: 500ms                                                   │
│      • BackoffFactor: 2.0                                                    │
│      • RetryableErrors: [9200, 9201, 9202]                                  │
│                                                                              │
│   ✅ GRACEFUL DEGRADATION                                                    │
│      • Backend failover (Ollama → llama.cpp)                                │
│      • Model fallback (32b → 8b if OOM)                                     │
│      • Offline mode (cached responses)                                       │
│                                                                              │
│   ✅ MONITORING                                                              │
│      • Structured logging (slog)                                             │
│      • Health checks every 30s                                               │
│      • Error rate dashboards                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│   ✅ USER FEEDBACK                                                           │
│      • Clear error messages                                                  │
│      • Suggested actions                                                     │
│      • Recovery instructions                                                 │
│                                                                              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
